mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals labor market weakness, triggering corporate earnings concerns and negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in >55% of instances where UNRATE > 6.5% over 5-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weak consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, with positive returns in >55% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: During post-2008 recovery phases, stable FEDFUNDS below 0.5% indicates sustained accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods classified as post-2008 recovery with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising payroll employment consistently signals labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with rising PAYEMS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1000.0 thousand units indicate housing market contraction, reducing construction activity and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are positive in >55% of instances where HOUST < 1000.0 over 5-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production and GDP growth signal supply chain disruption and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative return signal fails when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, with positive returns in >55% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production with stable GDP growth indicates strong economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods classified as early-cycle expansion with rising INDPRO.
